title: Chain Middle
description: Given a singly linked chain of nodes, print the value of its middle node. When the chain has an even number of nodes, return the second middle node.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n node values in chain order.
outputFormat: Print the value of the middle node.
hints: Move one pointer twice as fast as the other.

examples.explanation: 30 is the middle node of the five-node chain.
For an even-sized chain, the second middle node is selected.
